label: Some necessary concrete being at w has a power for there being no contingent concretum
paraphrase: Conclusion of the Pruss reconstruction: some concrete candidate exists at w, exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2 de re) and has at w a power for there being no contingent concrete being. It asserts no uniqueness, simplicity, firstness, intellect or God, and nothing about the power's exercise.
